data.name: Hunt For Gods
data.detailed_description:
Acesso antecipado à versão beta

Want to participate in the Hunt For Gods Public Test? Click here to install it now.


Acerca do jogo







Hunt For Gods is an RTS/ Hero TPS game for competitive MMO players, for when you want to fight without giving up on strategy.It's the only game In which two roles cooperate in the same team: lead your team as a God or fight as a Hunter in a last-man-standing battle among 3 teams.


Hunt For Gods is completely Free-to-Play. Anything that affects the gameplay can be unlocked simply by playing, except for the cosmetic items available for purchases.


A game in Hunt For Gods lasts about 5 minutes. No need to stay there for an hour before the game ends. And if you lose, you can start a new game instantly.


In Hunt For Gods, 3 Teams made up of 1 God and 4 Hunters fight each other:
The God, a strategic player that can also play in VR, guides his pawns (the "Hunters") from the sky, ensuring their victory thanks to his global vision, custom skills and soldiers.

The Hunters, which can choose among several characters with an unique skill set, fight in the arena in order to defeat the Guardians and collect the Divine Pages before their enemies.

You choose what role you want to play at the beginning of each game.


Friends make everything better. In Hunt For Gods, you can team up with your friends and play together vs. other players or bots.


As a God, you lead real humans instead of just bots. You can finally show who the real leader is after all these years spent playing RTS games.


There's no respawn, so it's GAME OVER as soon as you die. As an Hunter, your priority is to stay alive and crash your enemies before they crash you. You'll have to use all your skills and masteries to stay alive. Are you ready for the challenge?

15 players, 3 teams, one rule: get the pages and survive.

This page is here only to help the former devs and artists find new jobs in the industry.Hunt For Gods was a competitive, non pay-to-win, hero shooter game in which each of the 3 teams is led by a strategic player named God.

reviews.review:
This game is obviously made by non English speakers, I don't hold that against them as it's sort of adorable to try and watch them type in proper English. Yes, I realize that this game is still in early access but I've stated time and time again in previous reviews that being in early access is not an excuse to either have the players essentially make the game for you (This is in reference to the Devs more often then not, responding to criticisms by asking how to fix their own game. If players really knew the answer to this they would be playing that probably better game.), or to release a game that is clearly not ready to charge players any real cash value. I read through a lot of other reviews before downloading this game, most of which seemed to be along the vein of "This seems like a good idea, it's just poorly executed." If that phrase, which pretty much sums it up, is enough for you i recommend you stop reading my review here, but if you are legitimately interested in what this game has to offer you then read on brave Triangular adventurer.

I noticed while looking through the god skills that Poseidon seems to lack an accurate description of how long enemies are stunned for. There is a blank space where the number of seconds should be for the water trap skill. I am not sure if that is just for me. This all looks very rushed to me as I looked through the game for the first time. For some reason the art for the abilities far surpasses the art for the actual characters which looks like it was picked from a contest of the Devs favorite fan art and not a professional artist. The character models look alright I suppose, I am alright with less graphics in exchange for more game play, but with games lasting 2-5 minutes each I see a lack of game play already.

Little things are still off, like when you look through the list of characters and press the back button to return to look at more of those characters, it instead returns you to the menu screen and not to the previous page you were on (Edit 1hr later: I did notice there is a little X in the top right which does actually take you back).  It's a small thing, but when you have to do this ten times, and this literally triples the number of actions you have to do in order to look at just one more character it quickly became tiresome for me. When you enter the matchmaking system god forbid you realize you have something else to do because there is no way to exit out of it aside from totally shutting down the game. (ALT+F4)

I was primarily interested in playing as a god and helping direct my team. Poseidon seemed like a legit choice seeing as he can heal his people pretty well.  The control scheme is reminiscent of most MOBA's with QWERFT and sometimes the shift key all playing a role in skill use. It works alright for the most part although I can say that this game is no where as nearly as rewarding to play or win in as other MOBA's *cough* DOTA, HOTS, LOL *cough*. Not to mention that the moment you win, the game unceremoniously kicks you to a Victory or Defeat screen with no information or warning hoping to the gods of what I presume are Greek folklore you will play again.

 99% of the time you can't really tell when your team is about to win or lose because people may be alive one second, and then ganged up on the next and movement is too slow to allow for any real escape for players on the ground, so death is practically inevitable. Only having one life really hurts the game in this aspect because first of all, no one really gets a chance to practice against other players unless you play a hell of a lot of five minute games or you play the 1v1 vs a bot which as far as I can tell involves absolutely terrible AI. All the times I've tried to communicate with my team via typing has ended in no response from them, and I'm not really sure other players actually pay attention to the signals that the Gods put down and just sort of do their own thing until they accidentally win or lose. Strategy is also non existent unless you know how to create and follow through on a strategy within 2-5 minutes. By the way, enjoy the one map that exists and you will play on over and over.


There is a button called Factions that- Wait... what is the purpose of the factions tab? Lore? I scoff at this idea since most of the game appears to be written in a way which makes me want to read as little as I can get away with about these characters. AKA it is written in barely passable English. (it's normally not that bad...but sometimes it is.)

Ohoho, now... let me tell you about the store. It seems pretty much entirely useless to me and hopefully to you. While the store does tout some skins you may be able to buy, as well as a chest and a key to open said chest, as well as a Characters founder pack and a "Complete Founders Pack". Remember though that currently all characters are playable all ten ground and four gods, and as far as I can tell they are asking for 35$ and 65$ respectively for the packs.

 I can't for the life of me think of anyone who would want to give these people money (at the moment or any direct future moment). All of the skins look like they might be interesting, but the Devs decided that all you need to know about said skins is a mediocre facial portrait of the idea of the skin, and yes, you can click on the "See Details" button and then on the arrow at the bottom to see another piece of background fan art which probably vaguely represents the skin, but nothing that ACTUALLY SHOWS YOU WHAT THE SKIN LOOKS LIKE ON THE CHARACTER MODEL. Probably the least important part of any transaction involving real money and purchasing something which would hopefully change the way your character looks (sarcasm), and not just change the way the background portrait looks, but who really knows? And Mya help those two people who do. (Because she is "The Healer of Peoples")

I know I am crapping a lot on this game but there is frankly a lot to crap on and so very little that smells not of feces or that at the very least doesn't leave you wondering why your fingertips are stained ever so lightly an embarrassing shade of brown... 

P.S. Props to Potato, the guy/gal ranked number 1 on the ranked listings.

P.P.S. Read the Comments for my Dev Response. It's not perfect, but it will have to do.
reviews.developer_response:
Hi Ingredients,
thank you for your review. Unfortunately, most of the things you're talking about are actually "solved" (I.E: games are going to become "best of 3" instead of "first winner wins" and "how you won" is coming too) or "work in progress" (bots responsive to pings, minimap, etc..) and will comes in the next patches.

- Skins preview: we already tought about that and it's going to come in the near future, so, again, no problem.

- Back button that allows you to do what you were complaining about in the previous sentence before discovering that the button was there doing exactly what you wanted it to do: I'm curious about the alternative.

- "Dev's don't tell you how much poseidon stuns last" : it's just a (known) bug of that screen. It displays correctly in game, but of course you didn't care about mentioning it (or maybe you didn't notice it). EDIT: solved in the next patch.

- "The healer of peopleS": it is correct, because it is meant as "The healer of more than one populace/folk", not as "The healer of more than one person".

- Shop being there: I honestly don't get what's your problem with it, since nobody is asking you to buy anything and all the characters are actually unlocked for free at the moment.

- Team mates not replying/reacting to your chat messages / pings: I don't think it's the devs fault, is it?

A big part of your review is actually good/useful (of course you can't know what we're already working at... maybe we should do a public trello board to solve this?), and I hope that my reply will solve your doubts.
